player_prompt.intro:
Ngai Tower of Hanoi {num_disks} hte hkan hta ginpai ai.
Ngai tower A na tower C e hkan hta shadun na mat sai.
Hkan shadun na, source tower na target tower (e.g., '[A C]') rai nna.
Note that ngai tower hta top hkan hta shadun na mat sai, na hte masha hkan hta hpang hkan na shadun na mat sai.
Htawng madat na, submit one move ai.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: N jaw ai npawt nhpang (sh) bandung hpe nang tsun da sai.
invalid_move.empty_tower: N nga ai langchyi kaw nna disk langai hpe htawt sit mayu yang, nang galaw wa na re.
invalid_move.same_tower: Dai sha n-ga, nang gaw dai shadaw kaw nna disk langai hpe mung htawt bang mayu ai.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Grau kaba ai disk hpe, kaji htum re ai kaw bang mayu nna galaw wa sai.

game_action.moved: Ngai {disk} hte ga {source} na {target} e shangun ai.

outcome.win: Kabu gara ai lam! Nang gaw Hanoi Tower a manghkang hpe hparan lu sai.
outcome.turn_limit: Htawng madat na mat sai. Ngai {pct}% hte hkan hta Tower C e shadun ai.
